prompt: Write the body (about 180 words) of a demand letter from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer before a lawsuit. Accident: rear-end collision. Injury: back strain. Use the exact placeholders [CLIENT_NAME], [LOSS_DATE] and [DEMAND_AMOUNT]. No other names or dates. (Internal reference C-1163; do not mention it.)
text:
I am writing on behalf of our client, [CLIENT_NAME], regarding the rear-end collision that occurred on [LOSS_DATE]. The available facts show that your insured's vehicle struck the rear of our client's vehicle while our client was stopped in traffic. The police report and the photographs taken at the scene support this account, and liability for the collision rests squarely with your insured.

As a direct result of the impact, our client sustained a lumbar back strain. Following the collision, our client experienced persistent pain, muscle spasms, and restricted movement that interfered with daily activities and employment duties. Our client sought prompt medical evaluation and has been following the treatment plan recommended by the treating physician, including physical therapy and prescribed medication. Medical records documenting the diagnosis, treatment, and ongoing symptoms are enclosed.

Our client has incurred medical expenses and lost wages, and continues to experience discomfort. Accordingly, we demand payment of [DEMAND_AMOUNT] to resolve this claim in full. This demand will remain open for thirty days from the date of this letter. If we do not receive a satisfactory response within that period, we will file suit without further notice to your company.
